current_freeze.rule: This plan does not amend the existing Spanish/Japanese freeze. Exact models, prompts, evidence, sampling, repetitions and analysis code require a new freeze.

tier_definition.basis: prospective active-parameter bands, not universal quality claims; MoE total parameters recorded separately

tiers.role: multilingual candidate generation and simple evidence synthesis
complex semantic discrimination and evidence integration

tier_definition.undisclosed_policy: Models without disclosed active parameter counts are supplementary size_unclassified and excluded from the four-tier primary contrast.

model_freeze_requirements: immutable weights revision or endpoint version
temperature top-p seed reasoning and output limits
retrieval version and evidence rendering hash

evidence_arms.description: English HPO record and permitted structural context; no translated lexical evidence
E0 plus eligible U2 existing translation atoms, exact-language and lineage-deduplicated
E1 plus predicate-, direction-, semantic-loss- and rights-safe mapping and structural evidence
Authorized lineage-deduplicated source evidence rendered without model rewriting; non-generative evidence baseline
Exact existing Spanish/Japanese HPO translation comparator, withheld from generators and panel until lock

design.cells: four tiers crossed with E0 E1 and E2; B1 evidence-only baseline and R0 withheld comparator per concept-language unit
design.randomization: concept-blocked; paired seeds and evidence-order permutations; opaque condition IDs
design.blinding: panel sees no tier arm provider source or generator identity
design.common_context: primary uses smallest supported frozen context budget and identical canonical atoms
design.repetitions: three independently seeded calls per tier-arm-unit in Stage 1 and pilot; five on frozen reliability subset
design.failures: all calls, invalid outputs and failures retained in randomized reproducibility cost and nonacceptance denominators

source_binding.rule: Only assignments whose exact payload, language, edition, route, purpose, rights and new-freeze gates close may enter E1 or E2; weakest gate controls.
source_binding.existing_translation: F01_withheld_hpo_reference supplies R0 only and may not enter same-item generation.

estimands: within-tier E1 minus E0 and E2 minus E0 evidence effects
each generative cell versus R0 without treating R0 as ground truth
clinically significant error and zero-edit acceptance
latency tokens calls retries energy proxy and pinned-price cost

analysis_rules.language: Spanish and Japanese reported separately; no pooled sparse-cell rescue
analysis_rules.primary_factorial_model: tier, evidence arm, tier-by-arm interaction, language and language interactions; concept random intercept; repetition nested within cell
analysis_rules.tier_order: categorical primary; ordinal trend secondary only
analysis_rules.model_nesting: multiple models per tier require frozen nested model-within-tier factor
analysis_rules.judge_overlap: record generator-judge family overlap and run family-disjoint sensitivity when feasible
analysis_rules.margins: no noninferiority or minimum-gain margin may be invented after outcomes; estimation only until accountable margins are frozen
analysis_rules.sampling: confirmatory N simulated from pilot concept clustering, event rates, failures, repetitions and multiplicity

leakage_controls: withhold same-item HPO translation and HPO-derived lineage from all generators
fresh isolated context per call and no cross-cell memory
identical prompt semantics and evidence bundle across tiers
development-only prompt adaptation with equal frozen budget
held-out recent concepts and temporal replay sensitivity
deduplicate candidate text but retain every call
non_estimability: missing tier blocks the four-tier contrast
unavailable or prohibited evidence makes paired evidence effect non-estimable
no model or source substitution after unblinding
endpoint prompt evidence or model drift invalidates the run
